messages.content:
Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

an art gallery has only paintings and sculptures . currently , 1 / 3 of the pieces of art are displayed , and 1 / 6 of the pieces on display are sculptures . if 1 / 3 of the pieces not on display are paintings , and 1000 sculptures are not on display , how many pieces of art does the gallery have ?

A. 360
B. 2250
C. 540
D. 640
E. 720

message.content:
Sculptures not on display = (2/3)(1 − 1/3 of not-displayed are paintings) = (2/3)(2/3)T = 4T/9 = 1000 → T = 2250.

ANSWER: B
message.reasoning_content: Not on display = 2/3 total; 1/3 of those are paintings → sculptures not displayed = 2/3 of not-displayed = 4/9 of total? Wait sculptures not on display = 2/3 × (2/3 T)= 4T/9 =1000 → T=2250. B.

final_content:

ANSWER: B
